_doc: tools/import_audio.py 가 만든다. bgm = 반복(들어가는 부분은 <큐>_intro), jingle = 한 번(len 초 뒤 다음 곡), sfx = 효과음. src = 원본 파일.

bgm_daily_summer.src: 1-16. Living in a Lazy Parallel World.mp3

bgm_daily_night.src: 3-05. Beautiful Lie in the Virtual World.mp3

bgm_daily_mono.use: 5장 일상(V3 도 일상은 대부분 Beautiful Lie)

v4_clock_tick.use: quiet wall clock: trigger once per actual timer second, never use as universal BGM

v4_clock_tock.use: alternate clock tick, same clock source

v4_distant_bell.use: single original offscreen bell resonance; no borrowed melody

v4_musicbox_single.use: one original toy-music-box pluck; authored sequence separate

v4_footstep_tile_1.use: tile footstep variation; trigger foot-contact event, alternate without machine-gun repetition

v4_footstep_tile_2.use: tile footstep variation; trigger foot-contact event, alternate without machine-gun repetition

v4_footstep_wood_1.use: wood footstep variation; trigger foot-contact event, alternate without machine-gun repetition

v4_footstep_wood_2.use: wood footstep variation; trigger foot-contact event, alternate without machine-gun repetition

v4_footstep_metal_1.use: metal footstep variation; trigger foot-contact event, alternate without machine-gun repetition

v4_footstep_metal_2.use: metal footstep variation; trigger foot-contact event, alternate without machine-gun repetition

v4_footstep_cloth_1.use: cloth footstep variation; trigger foot-contact event, alternate without machine-gun repetition

v4_footstep_cloth_2.use: cloth footstep variation; trigger foot-contact event, alternate without machine-gun repetition

v4_ui_focus.use: focus CHANGED event only, never every frame

v4_ui_reject.use: disabled/invalid request rejected, no state advance

v4_evidence_revised.use: same evidence version updated, not duplicated acquisition

v4_paper_turn.use: page-turn start; throttle on fast backlog scrolling

v4_paper_insert.use: comic piece successfully inserted after placement validation

v4_metal_latch_close.use: latch seats, after closed pose actually reached

v4_door_wood_close.use: door-leaf close contact, not open permission event

v4_door_hinge.use: quiet stylized hinge movement, trim/fade on interrupted animation

v4_ink_impact.use: single decisive hit feedback, never overwrite logical hit test

v4_ink_slice.use: single ink slash gesture, no real injury sound

v4_miss_brush.use: non-hit deflection, distinct from successful impact

v4_memory_scan.use: one rewind/readback transition, no extra use or success claim

v4_camera_shutter.use: physical camera shutter only when story permits real capture

v4_amb_outside_wind.use: park air, no implied live machinery

v4_amb_machine_hum.use: powered maintenance equipment, stop when disconnected

v4_amb_water_flow.use: actual running-water emitter only. Dry fountain MUST NOT receive this cue; use existing recorded fountain-speaker story cue separately.
